name: the entity pageType takes its own Images page
why: _dgPage()'s path pattern is not anchored at the end: without the exclusion dg-master (earlier in pageDefinitions) claims /master/<id>/images with its Versions button.

name: the Images pages are not let past the #app gate
why: Older pages without #app, like Cloudflare's check: without their path in the gate the script stops there.

name: the type column says the API's lowercase word
why: Primary / Secondary, as a release's Images table writes them.
